title: cardiaca marrubiastrum
intro: Cardiaca marrubiastrum, commonly known as Marrubium, is a perennial plant belonging to the Lamiaceae family. This plant has been found to possess several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of digestive issues and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Cardiaca marrubiastrum include its ability to soothe and calm irritated tissues, making it effective in treating conditions such as asthma and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include diterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
